prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use a mirror-selfie first-person perspective throughout a 14-second 9:16 fashion film. An adult East Asian woman with long straight black hair wears a creamy white stand-collar zippered jacket and shorts set and holds a phone toward the mirror. In a warm Nordic-style home with a fireplace, bookshelves, soft fill halos, creamy white and wood-brown tones, she examines herself with a cool calm expression. From 3-6 seconds, she lowers the phone, slowly unzips the jacket to reveal a covered cream base layer, turns to show the outfit from behind, and glances back with a faint smile. From 6-10 seconds, she quickly puts on a sheer cream lace cover-up over the base layer, turns to the mirror, and shifts from languid to confident. From 10-14 seconds, she arranges her hair, looks down briefly, then looks directly at the mirror as the lens pulls back to a full-body view and freezes on the warm bokeh. Keep the outfit transitions non-explicit, preserve the fireplace atmosphere, and include no subtitles or interface.
